svg.aria-label: CPU memory traffic against expected KV-cache reads
svg.title: CPU memory traffic against expected KV-cache reads
svg.text: CPU attention reads the KV cache it needs, and no more
One dot per measured language block in which NEO decoded on the CPU. x: KV-cache bytes the CPU must read
(CPU-decoded tokens/s × context × KV bytes per token). y: reads counted by the memory controllers during the block.
Peak memory bandwidth was not measured; a single-thread copy on PC1 moved 49 GB/s (reads + writes).
